favourite.heading: Why Houston can pull away
bullets: Houston is the better football team by 8.0 points on opponent-adjusted results — but about 74% of that rating is still last season carried forward, and in a portal era last season is a different team (-8.0 pts).
Conference strength differs and the in-season sample is still thin, worth 5.7 points to Houston (-5.7 pts).
Stylistically the matchup favours Houston by 0.7 points: ball control vs front disruption (-0.7 pts).

underdog.heading: Why Georgia Southern can keep it close
bullets: Playing at Georgia Southern is worth 4.1 points — the league-wide home-field number, because a per-venue table was tested and could not be told apart from the home team’s own quality (+4.1 pts).
The outcome range is 15.3 points wide at one sigma — p10 -33.4 to p90 +10.6 for Georgia Southern, so a projection of -10.4 still produces results a long way either side of it.
It is early enough that both ratings still lean on preseason belief — it widens the outcome range by about 4%.
College ratings are built on twelve-game seasons against wildly uneven schedules; even a clean rating gap carries more estimation error than the number implies.
